content.json:
# GitHub Actions self-hosted runner fleet

Operational dashboard for the Azure-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet (VMSS backend). Pick a **time range**, the **Log Analytics workspace**, and the **scale set** below, then use the tabs to move between views.

| Tab | What it answers |
|---|---|
| **Fleet overview** | Is the fleet healthy right now? How many runners, how busy, anything failing? |
| **Compute health** | CPU / memory / disk / network per runner (utilisation & saturation). |
| **Capacity & autoscale** | Queue depth, instance count over time, why autoscale did or didn't act. |
| **Provisioning & bootstrap** | Did each instance finish `bootstrap_agent.sh` and register as a runner? |
| **Logs & errors** | OS-level warnings/errors, out-of-memory kills, auth failures. |
| **Queue-metric function** | Health of the optional Function App that publishes the autoscale metric. |
| **Alerts** | Alerts firing against the fleet, plus the alert rules you should have. |

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| where tags['workload'] =~ '${workload_tag}' or name startswith 'log-ghrunner'
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true

parameters.name: Fleet
parameters.label: Scale set
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| where tags['workload'] =~ '${workload_tag}' or name startswith 'vmss-ghrunner'
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true

content.json:
## Fleet overview
Everything on this tab is scoped to the last 24 hours (KPI tiles) or the selected time range (charts). "Runner" = a VMSS instance whose Azure Monitor Agent is reporting a heartbeat.

content.query: Heartbeat | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | summarize Runners = dcount(Computer) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | render areachart
content.title: Runner count over time (heartbeat)
Runners - current state (last 15 min)

content.json:
## Compute health
Per-runner utilisation and saturation, sampled by the Azure Monitor Agent every 60s (`Perf` table). Watch for CPU pinned at 100% (jobs starved), `Available MBytes` trending to zero (OOM risk - see **Logs & errors**), or disk `% Used Space` climbing toward the thresholds.

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Processor' and CounterName == '% Processor Time' | summarize CPU_pct = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | render timechart
content.title: CPU %  - average per runner

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == '% Used Memory' | summarize Mem_used_pct = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | render timechart
content.title: Memory used %  - average per runner

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == 'Available MBytes' | summarize Available_MB = min(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | render timechart
content.title: Available memory (MB)  - minimum per runner

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Logical Disk' and CounterName == '% Used Space' | where InstanceName !startswith '/snap' and InstanceName !in ('_Total', '/boot/efi') | summarize Used_pct = max(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Mount = strcat(Computer, ' ', InstanceName) | render timechart
content.title: Disk used %  - per mount

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Logical Disk' and CounterName == '% Used Space' | where InstanceName !startswith '/snap' and InstanceName !in ('_Total', '/boot/efi') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName | extend Used_pct = round(CounterValue, 1) | where Used_pct >= toreal('{DiskWarn}') | extend Severity = iff(Used_pct >= toreal('{DiskCrit}'), 'Critical', 'Warning') | project Computer, Mount = InstanceName, Used_pct, Severity, TimeGenerated | sort by Used_pct desc
content.title: Low disk space - mounts at or over the warn threshold

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Logical Disk' and CounterName in ('Disk Read Bytes/sec', 'Disk Write Bytes/sec') | summarize Bytes_per_sec = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), CounterName | render timechart
content.title: Disk throughput (bytes/sec)

content.query: Perf | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where ObjectName == 'Network' and CounterName in ('Total Bytes Received', 'Total Bytes Transmitted') | summarize Bytes_per_sec = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), CounterName | render timechart
content.title: Network throughput (bytes/sec)

content.json:
## Capacity & autoscale
The fleet scales on **queued GitHub jobs** (the `${custom_metric_name}` custom metric in the `${custom_metric_namespace}` namespace on the scale set). Autoscale adds an instance per queued job and drains to the floor when the queue is quiet.

> The scale-action and evaluation grids need diagnostic logs from the autoscale setting flowing to this workspace (`enable_autoscale_diagnostics = true` in Terraform). If they are empty, that setting is off.

content.query: Heartbeat | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | summarize Runners = dcount(Computer) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | render columnchart
content.title: Runner count over time (heartbeat proxy for capacity)

content.query: AutoscaleScaleActionsLog | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Autoscale - scale actions

content.query: AutoscaleEvaluationsLog | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Autoscale - evaluations (why it did / didn't scale)

content.json:
## Provisioning & bootstrap
At first boot each instance runs `bootstrap_agent.sh`, which logs to **syslog facility `local0`** (tag `ghrunner-bootstrap`) - shipped here by the Data Collection Rule. A healthy instance logs `Bootstrap complete ... registered and running.` An instance that heartbeats but never logs that line is stuck part-way through provisioning.

content.query:
let prefix = '${computer_prefix}';
Syslog | where Facility == 'local0' | where Computer startswith prefix
| summarize FirstLog = min(TimeGenerated), LastLog = max(TimeGenerated),
            Completed = countif(SyslogMessage has 'Bootstrap complete'),
            Errors = countif(SyslogMessage has_cs 'ERROR' or SyslogMessage has_cs 'FATAL' or SyslogMessage has 'still failing after')
  by Computer
| extend Status = case(Completed > 0, 'Completed', Errors > 0, 'Failed', 'In progress / unknown')
| project Computer, Status, Errors, FirstLog, LastLog
| sort by LastLog desc
content.title: Bootstrap outcome per instance
Instances stuck in provisioning (heartbeat, no completed bootstrap)

content.query: Syslog | where Facility == 'local0' | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where SyslogMessage has_cs 'ERROR' or SyslogMessage has_cs 'FATAL' or SyslogMessage has_cs 'WARN' or SyslogMessage has 'failed' | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SyslogMessage | sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Bootstrap error / warning lines

content.query: Syslog | where Facility == 'local0' | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessName, SyslogMessage | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 1000
content.title: Full bootstrap log (facility local0)

content.query: AzureActivity | where ResourceProvider =~ 'Microsoft.Compute' | where ActivityStatusValue in ('Failure', 'Failed') | project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, _ResourceId | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Azure control-plane failures (needs Activity Log -> this workspace)

content.json:
## Logs & errors
OS-level syslog from every runner (the DCR collects `auth`, `authpriv`, `cron`, `daemon`, `kern`, `syslog`, `user` at Warning and above). Use this to catch the failure modes that don't show up as a metric: the kernel OOM-killer reaping a job, SSH brute-force noise, cron failures.

content.query: Syslog | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where SeverityLevel in ('warning', 'err', 'error', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg') | summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Facility | render timechart
content.title: Warning+ syslog volume by facility

content.query: Syslog | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where SeverityLevel in ('err', 'error', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg') | summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Example = any(SyslogMessage) by ProcessName, Facility | sort by Count desc
content.title: Top error sources

content.query: Syslog | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where SyslogMessage has 'Out of memory' or SyslogMessage has 'oom-kill' or SyslogMessage has 'oom_reaper' or SyslogMessage has 'Killed process' | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SyslogMessage | sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Out-of-memory killer events

content.query: Syslog | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | where Facility in ('auth', 'authpriv') | where SyslogMessage has 'Failed password' or SyslogMessage has 'authentication failure' or SyslogMessage has 'invalid user' | summarize Attempts = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | sort by Attempts desc
content.title: Authentication failures

content.query: Syslog | where Computer startswith '${computer_prefix}' | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, SyslogMessage | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 500
content.title: Syslog explorer (latest 500)

content.json:
## Queue-metric function
Only populated when the optional Function App is deployed (`enable_queue_metric_function = true`). It publishes the `${custom_metric_name}` autoscale metric from a GitHub `workflow_job` webhook plus a 3-minute timer, and runs an hourly cleanup of orphaned runner registrations. Data comes from its workspace-based Application Insights (`App*` tables).

content.query: AppRequests | where AppRoleName startswith '${queue_fn_role_prefix}' | summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), Name | render columnchart
content.title: Function invocations (success vs failed)

content.query: AppExceptions | where AppRoleName startswith '${queue_fn_role_prefix}' | project TimeGenerated, ProblemId, OuterMessage, OperationName | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Function exceptions

content.query: AppTraces | where AppRoleName startswith '${queue_fn_role_prefix}' | where Message has '${custom_metric_name}' or Message has 'metric' or Message has 'Published' | project TimeGenerated, Message, SeverityLevel | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Metric-publish and cleanup traces

content.json:
## Alerts
Alerts currently firing against the fleet (Azure Monitor, last 24h). If this is empty and you expected coverage, the rules below are not created yet - set `enable_monitoring_alerts = true` (and `monitoring_alert_email`) in Terraform, or create them by hand.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend e = parse_json(properties).essentials
| extend Fired = todatetime(e.startDateTime), Severity = tostring(e.severity), State = tostring(e.alertState), Rule = tostring(e.alertRule), Target = tostring(e.targetResource)
| where Fired > ago(24h)
| where Target contains 'ghrunner'
| project Fired, name, Severity, State, Rule, Target
| sort by Fired desc
content.title: Fired alerts (last 24h)

content.json:
### Recommended alert rules

| Alert | Signal | Condition | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Low disk space** | `Perf` - `Logical Disk` / `% Used Space`, split by `Computer` | `>= {DiskCrit}` for 15 min | 2 (warning at `>= {DiskWarn}`) |
| **High CPU** | Scale set metric `Percentage CPU` | `> {CpuCrit}` avg over 15 min | 3 |
| **Low memory** | `Perf` - `Memory` / `Available MBytes`, split by `Computer` | `< ${mem_low_mb}` for 15 min | 3 |
| **Bootstrap failure** | `Syslog` `Facility == 'local0'` with `ERROR` / `FATAL` | any in 10 min | 1 |
| **Runner heartbeat lost** | `Heartbeat`, split by `Computer` | no beat for 15 min while any instance is expected | 2 |
| **Autoscale action failed** | `AutoscaleScaleActionsLog` where `ResultType != 'Succeeded'` | any in 15 min | 2 |
| **Scale set provisioning failed** | Activity Log - `Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets` write, status `Failed` | any | 1 |

`enable_monitoring_alerts = true` in `terraform.tfvars` provisions the first five plus an email action group (`monitoring_alert_email`). The last two are documented for you to add against your own action group / Activity Log.
